# hunch install: examples

`install` writes `hunch.lock`: it copies the packs the config names, and turns Agent Skills and `AGENTS.md` into review questions with a coding agent. Here the shop's config selects its one skill and its root `AGENTS.md` (`skills: ["./.agents/skills/api-style"]`, `agentsMd: true`) and names no pack.

<!-- case: install-dry -->
### What would be installed?

```sh
npx -y --min-release-age=0 @kelbie/hunch install --dry-run
```

Exit code **0**.

stdout:

```text
hunch: dry run, nothing written. 2 of 2 source(s) would be compiled.
  new        skill/api-style  .agents/skills/api-style/SKILL.md
  new        agents-md/root  AGENTS.md
Packs are copied verbatim; only the changed sources cost an agent call.
```

<!-- /case -->

<!-- case: install-packs-dry -->
### Two packs, one of them in part

`packs: ["nuts-spec", { pack: "bips-spec", rules: ["bip32/*"] }]`. A dry run compares the config with the lock and fetches nothing; `install` then copies the rules in.

```sh
npx -y --min-release-age=0 @kelbie/hunch install --dry-run
```

Exit code **0**.

stdout:

```text
hunch: dry run, nothing written. 2 pack(s) would be copied; 2 of 2 source(s) would be compiled.
  new        pack/nuts-spec  nuts-spec
  new        pack/bips-spec  bips-spec
  new        skill/api-style  .agents/skills/api-style/SKILL.md
  new        agents-md/root  AGENTS.md
Packs are copied verbatim; only the changed sources cost an agent call.
```

<!-- /case -->

<!-- case: install-noninteractive -->
### No terminal, no previous lock, no --with

Guidance needs a compiler, so an agent must say which one to use. A config with packs alone never reaches this.

```sh
npx -y --min-release-age=0 @kelbie/hunch install
```

Exit code **2**.

stderr:

```text
hunch: choose a compiler with --with claude, --with codex or --with gateway.
```

<!-- /case -->

<!-- case: install-nothing -->
### Nothing to install

```sh
npx -y --min-release-age=0 @kelbie/hunch install --dry-run
```

Exit code **2**.

stderr:

```text
hunch: nothing to install: the config names no pack, and no skills, AGENTS.md or docs were found. Name a pack (`packs: ["nuts-spec"]`), add an AGENTS.md, install a skill (`npx skills add <owner/repo>`), or list files under `docs`; then run `npx @kelbie/hunch install` again.
```

<!-- /case -->
